source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.06289 (Cable, Mani, Qi, Sotiropoulos & Xiong, 'On the Efficacy of Shorting Corporate Bonds as a Tail Risk Hedging Solution', q-fin.PM 2025: momentum, liquidity (TRACE) and credit (option-implied) signals time short-LQD hedges 2013-2022; Sortino +0.79 for the LQD hedge, no-cost case; thresholds tuned in-sample)

Bench LQD (variant AGG), 3bp, 2003+. Variants lookback 126, thresholds -1.0/-2.0. Momentum leg ONLY (the liquidity and option-implied credit signals need TRACE and LQD options IV)

source: lab (ingredients: Lustig-Roussanov-Verdelhan JFE 2014 https://www.nber.org/papers/w16427 ; Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen JFE 2012 TSMOM; R-2026-11-11-DOLCARRY; L-2026-11-09-HEDGEUUP)

name: Cross-sectional commodity carry without a futures curve: realised roll yield = ETF return minus its front-month future's price change (lab)
summary: Each month hold the 3 of 7 futures-based commodity ETFs whose realised roll over the last 63 days was highest (most backwardated markets); the unadjusted Yahoo front-month series jumps at each roll and the ETF does not, so their difference measures the roll yield
source: lab (premium: Koijen-Moskowitz-Pedersen-Vrugt 'Carry' JFE 127(2) 2018 https://econpapers.repec.org/RePEc:eee:jfinec:v:127:y:2018:i:2:p:197-225 ; Gorton-Rouwenhorst FAJ 2006 ; Erb-Harvey FAJ 2006 ; WisdomTree Jan 2026 https://www.wisdomtree.com/gb/insights/blog/please-mind-the-slope-why-futures-curves-matter (XS front roll yield 5.5%/yr, t 3.1, 2001-25))

Bench DBC; 5bp; 2011-09-01+. Variants lb 42/126, top 2/4. New family L-2026-11-11-ETFROLL: trials 5. Prints proxy_diagnostic (mean annualised roll per ETF, share of months held; no verdict). name: Momentum turning points: blend slow and fast trend signals (Goulding-Harvey-Mazzoleni 2023, JFE)
